triples.head_surface: standstill damage to shaft seal and bearings
triples.head_canonical_zh: 轴封和轴承的静止损坏
triples.tail_surface: the shaft shall be rotated at least 2-3 times monthly
triples.evidence_text: On pumps not running, the shaft shall be rotated at least 2-3 times monthly to avoid standstill damage to shaft seal and bearings.

triples.head_surface: seizing of the impeller and/or the shaft seal
triples.tail_surface: more frequent shaft rotation or start-up
triples.evidence_text: In special applications, it may require more frequent shaft rotation or start-up in order to avoid seizing of the impeller and/or the shaft seal.

triples.tail_surface: lead liquid (either one way or the other) through a passively rotating pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 液体流过被动旋转的泵
triples.evidence_text: It is not recommended to lead liquid (either one way or the other) through a passively rotating pump, as this may damage the shaft seal.

triples.tail_surface: run at least 300 rpm and use max. 1 minute on acceleration from 0 to 300 rpm and max. 1 minute on deceleration from 300 to 0 rpm
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 运行至少300rpm且加减速时间不超过1分钟
triples.evidence_text: For the sake of the shaft seal lifetime, it is recommended to run at least 300 rpm and use max. 1 minute on acceleration from 0 to 300 rpm and max. 1 minute on deceleration from 300 to 0 rpm.
